description_expanded: Hermosa Manor - Luxury Vacation Rental House with Private Pool and Ocean View Favorite Features: - Private Pool (Heat Available) - 2 Min Walk to Beach - Game Room - Beachview - 2 Sets of Backpack Beach Chairs - 4 Bikes Included More about Hermosa Manor: Hermosa Manor is an expansive three-story eight-bedroom, eight-bathroom property capable of accommodating up to 28 guests. Nestled in Seagrove on 30A within the gated community of Secluded Dunes, it's a haven for large groups. The house features multiple living areas, bunk rooms, and balconies, with a private pool available with optional heating, and a boardwalk directly to the beach. Whether planning a memorable gathering or a multi-family vacation, Hermosa Manor is the ultimate destination! On the lower level, guests can unwind in a spacious den with a bathroom and access to a deck leading to a private pool and spa. This backyard oasis offers ample seating and a grill for poolside cookouts. Two bedrooms are available on this level: a bunk room with four sets of twin/twin bunks and a double queen bedroom, both with their own bathrooms, making it perfect for kids or singles in the group. The main floor, on the second level, boasts a luxurious kitchen with high-end appliances, a six-burner gas stove with a griddle, and an oversized island that can seat eight. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the kitchen to the living room and a dining area that can accommodate 12 guests around a large dining table. The living room exudes a beach elegance with a neutral color palette and abundant natural light from the large windows. For extra seating, there's an attached balcony for Al Fresco dining and outdoor living. The king primary suite, with a private bathroom featuring a soaking tub, walk-in shower, water closet, and dual vanities, is the sole bedroom on this level. A game room, complete with living area, two TV's a wet bar, and an array of board games, is also on this floor. The upper level offers five bedrooms, a living room area, and a kitchenette. There's a bunk room with two full/full bunks, a private balcony with gulf views, two TVs, and a game table. Following that is a bedroom with a twin bed and twin trundle. Two king suites with private bathroom are next and there's another king suite with a private bathroom, gulf views, and balcony access. Hermosa Manor's unique location, taking a stroll down the boardwalk to the beach, also take part in seeing the rare coastal Deer Lake part of the 15 named Dune Lakes in Florida offers guests the opportunity to witness a rare natural phenomenon found only in 5 locations around the world with Florida being 1 of 2 location in the United States. Guests can enjoy bike rides on the 30A bike path, leading to various destinations including family fun at the Big Chill or adult evenings out. With its numerous living areas, on-site amenities, and versatile sleeping arrangements, Hermosa Manor is the perfect choice for hosting large gatherings. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: 2 Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 2: 4 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.  Bedroom 6: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 7: 2 Full over Full Bunks & Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo. Bedroom 8: Twin Bed with Twin Trundle & Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo.
